title: McKinsey Deploys New AI Avatar as Client in Job Interviews
summary:
Job seekers at McKinsey offices are now participating in 10 minute simulated interactions with an artificial intelligence agent acting as a client. Company partners and assessors remain in the room during these sessions to monitor the candidates' behavior and performance in real time while they interact with the new avatar.

The deployment follows a broader increase in AI use throughout the recruitment cycle, including the adoption of AI amplified applications and algorithmic filters used by human resources departments to narrow candidate pools. These automated tools are altering the job application process more rapidly than AI is transforming the actual professional roles.
